description: Read one person's public professional profile, fetched FRESH at request time (never from a stored cache). Costs $0.0012 per live read, drawn from your balance; a profile that cannot be read is free. Pass a public identifier or profile address as `profile_ref`, OR the `person_ref` another read returned (a reactor, commenter or search result without a public identifier). Give exactly one. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged. Limits: no daily cap once the account has topped up; one per-account limit a minute sized to our read pool's live capacity (pricing_get people_reads.rate_limit_per_minute; over it 429 people_read_rate_limit with Retry-After, free); an account on the free signup balance only gets 100 of these reads a day (429 daily_read_limit until 00:00 UTC, free) until its first top-up.

person_ref.description: The person_ref another read returned for this person (post_engagers, people_search).

profile_ref.description: A person's public identifier or profile address.
